episodes.synopsis: Uesugi Fuutarou lands a tutoring job that promises five times the normal pay. As it turns out, it’s going to take more than five times the work.
episodes.title: The Quintessential Quintuplets

episodes.synopsis: Futaro proposes an exam to settle the debate of whether or not the quintuplets need a tutor.
episodes.title: Rooftop Confession

episodes.synopsis: Nino isn't happy that Futaro is beginning to get along with her sisters, so she takes matters into her own hands.
episodes.title: A Mountain of Problems

episodes.synopsis: Futaro receives his first pay, and decides to take Raiha to the arcade, where she’s always wanted to go.
episodes.title: A Day Off

episodes.synopsis: The fireworks have started, but the girls are still split up. Ichika wanders off on her own, and Futaro goes after her.
episodes.title: Five Fifths

episodes.synopsis: The midterm exams are coming up, and the girls' father set Futaro up to a seemingly impossible task.
episodes.title: What's Been Built Up

episodes.synopsis: Futaro spent the night at the quintuplets' apartment. He wakes up to an unexpected situation.
episodes.title: Liar McLieface

episodes.synopsis: Futaro falls ill after Miku feeds him a hefty serving of croquettes. Nino makes the situation even worse than it needs to be.
episodes.title: The Photo That Started It All

episodes.synopsis: School is abuzz about the camp school trip coming up. Meanwhile, Raiha catches the flu.
episodes.title: Legend of Fate Day 1

episodes.synopsis: Futaro and the girls arrive at camp school. His outfit for the test of courage causes more than just a scare for Nino.
episodes.title: Legend of Fate Day 2

episodes.synopsis: Ichika and Futaro get locked in the storage shed. The others are concerned about their absence, but not necessarily for the same reasons.
episodes.title: Legend of Fate Day 3

episodes.synopsis: It’s the last day of camp school. Itsuki is missing. Futaro thinks he knows where to find her, but he’s sick and shouldn’t be wandering in the snow.
episodes.title: Legend of Fate Day 2000
